basic_details.job_title: APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026 Cancelled – Official Notice PDF
basic_details.short_information: Update 2 Nov 2026: APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026 has been cancelled. Army Public School Bareilly has issued an official corrigendum cancelling the advertisement dated 24 October 2026 for Head Clerk, Account Clerk and Lower Division Clerk (LDC) posts on term basis. Candidates should refer to the official cancellation notice for details.

content_sections.heading: APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026 Cancellation Notice
content_sections.text: The corrigendum has been issued under the authority of the Principal, Army Public School Bareilly. The notice does not specify any reason for the cancellation or announce a revised recruitment schedule. Candidates who were planning to apply for these posts are advised to check the official school website for any further announcements.

content_sections.heading: APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026 Application Status
content_sections.text: The earlier notification invited candidates to submit the prescribed application form along with a Demand Draft of Rs 250/- to the Principal, Army Public School Bareilly, by 07 November 2026. However, following the official cancellation, the previously announced application deadline is no longer applicable. Candidates should not submit new applications or application fees under the cancelled notification. The cancellation corrigendum does not provide information about refunds of application fees or the treatment of applications already submitted. Applicants who have already applied may contact the school directly for clarification.

faq.question: Q1. Is APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026 cancelled?
faq.answer: Yes. Army Public School Bareilly has officially cancelled its recruitment advertisement dated 24 October 2026 for Head Clerk, Account Clerk and Lower Division Clerk (LDC) posts.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are affected by the APS Bareilly recruitment cancellation?
faq.answer: The cancellation applies to the Head Clerk, Account Clerk and Lower Division Clerk (LDC) posts advertised on term basis.

faq.question: Q3. Can candidates still apply for APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. The original recruitment advertisement has been cancelled. Candidates should not submit fresh applications under that notification.

faq.question: Q4. Why was APS Bareilly Recruitment 2026 cancelled?
faq.answer: The official corrigendum does not mention the reason for cancelling the recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. Will APS Bareilly release a new recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The school has not announced a fresh recruitment schedule in the cancellation notice. Candidates should monitor the official website for further updates.
